newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent steady, market waits for API release.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent steady, market waits for API release.

text.p: Brent crude futures were indicated steady to higher in Asia at midday on Wednesday, supported by a modest rebound on NYMEX.
April Brent on SIMEX was quoted at $19.22/$19.38 per barrel, after London shed four cents to settle at $19.24.
Meanwhile, NYMEX April crude rose 11 cents to $20.22 on ACCESS from New York's close of $20.11. May was up 11 at $20.40.
Brokers said the market appeared building for another downside test.
April Brent in London took out support at $19.00 and dropped to an intraday low of $18.93, while NYMEX April crude fell to $20.05, looking to test major support at $20.00.

However, market sentiment might be put on hold during Wednesday pending the delay in the release of API data. Computer problems delayed the normal Tuesday release of the data until at least Wednesday.
Crude had been expected to show a build of 3.5 million barrels, distillates a draw of 1.5 million and gasoline a draw of 500,000 barrels.
